no_self_scoring: The authoring assistant did not mark any answer human-correct. Current engineering results must not be reported as scores for this set.
release_rule: Human reviewers must resolve references, verify formulas and values, supply independent grouped images, then freeze a new approved protocol before formal model runs.

scoring.calculation: independent numerical reference, conditions, source and units
scoring.composition: all requested subgoals and inventory constraints
scoring.multiturn: correction invalidates old results and preserves valid inputs
scoring.unsupported: honest boundary, no invented answer or unsafe tool
scoring.visual: recognition scored separately before/after confirmation; source-group split
